/* printMapper.selectManualBarcodeList : Label Barcode print list */ SELECT ISNULL(od.SHIPPER_NAME, '') AS SHIPPER_NAME ,CONCAT(REPLACE(ISNULL(od.SHIPPER_ADDRESS, ''), '
', ''), REPLACE(ISNULL(od.SHIPPER_ADDRESS_A,''), '
', ''), REPLACE(ISNULL(od.SHIPPER_ADDRESS_B,''), '
', ''), REPLACE(ISNULL(od.SHIPPER_ADDRESS_C,''), '
', ''), REPLACE(ISNULL(od.SHIPPER_ADDRESS_D,''), '
', '')) AS SHIPPER_ADDRESS ,ISNULL(od.CONSIGNEE_NAME, '') AS CONSIGNEE_NAME ,CONCAT(REPLACE(ISNULL(od.CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS, ''), '
', ''), REPLACE(ISNULL(od.CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS_A,''), '
', ''), REPLACE(ISNULL(od.CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS_B,''), '
', ''), REPLACE(ISNULL(od.CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS_C,''), '
', ''), REPLACE(ISNULL(od.CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS_D,''), '
', '')) AS CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS ,od.HBL_NO ,od.ORIG_CODE ,od.DEST_CODE ,od.SHIPPER_TEL ,od.SHIPPER_ATTN ,od.CONSIGNEE_ATTN
,od.CONSIGNEE_CODE ,od.SHIPPER_CODE ,od.BOUND
,od.COMMODITY_ITEM AS ITEM_NAME
,(SELECT ENT_BUSINESS_NAME_ENG FROM TB_SMS_ENT_BUSINESS WHERE ENT_CODE = od.ENT_CODE AND ENT_BUSINESS_CODE = #{entBusinessCode}) AS ENT_BUSINESS_NAME ,ISNULL(od.ORIG_NAME, '') AS ORIG_NAME ,ISNULL(od.DEST_NAME, '') AS DEST_NAME ,ISNULL(od.PIECES, 0) AS PIECES ,ISNULL(od.GWT, 0.0) AS GWT ,ISNULL(CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), od.OB_DATE, 23), '') AS OB_DATE ,od.DELIVERY_PAYMENT_TYPE ,ISNULL((SELECT NAME_ENG FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL WHERE ENT_CODE = od.ENT_CODE AND GROUP_CODE='PAYMENT_GUBN' AND CODE = od.DELIVERY_PAYMENT_TYPE), '') AS PAYMENT
,dbo.Cryptography(od.OD_JOB_NO, od.CONSIGNEE_HP_ENC, 1) AS CONSIGNEE_HP ,dbo.Cryptography(od.OD_JOB_NO, od.CONSIGNEE_TEL_ENC, 1) AS CONSIGNEE_TEL
,od.CONSIGNEE_HP ,od.CONSIGNEE_TEL
FROM TB_ECM_OD od WHERE 1=1 AND od.OD_JOB_NO = #{odJobNo}
AND od.BL_TYPE_MH = #{BL_TYPE_MH}
